description: Defined names and a Name Manager on a Svelte 5 spreadsheet grid: an assumptions-driven twelve-month forecast where every formula reads a name, =B2*(1+Growth-Churn), instead of an address. The Name Box lists the names and jumps to a name's cell on the Assumptions sheet; Formulas > Name Manager adds, repoints and deletes names while the forecast recomputes. Inputs in blue, negatives red in parentheses, break-even found with INDEX and MATCH. Enterprise, in @svgrid/enterprise.

faq.question: How is a name defined?
faq.answer: Through Formulas > Name Manager, with a name and the range it refers to, or from code with createNames. Formulas then use the name in place of the address, and the Name Box lists it.

faq.question: What happens when a name is repointed?
faq.answer: Every formula that reads the name picks up the new cell on the next recalculation, so the forecast follows without editing a single formula.

faq.question: Do names cross sheets?
faq.answer: Yes. Growth and Churn live on the Assumptions sheet and the forecast on another; a name carries its sheet, so =B2*(1+Growth-Churn) works from anywhere in the workbook.
